scope: Five reviewer-included full-text studies in an explicitly bounded exploratory corpus; not global prevalence, completed index searches, or five peer-reviewed articles.
cohort_change: Targeted recovery of existing discovery records R015 and R020, not new search queries. S6 is an undated grey draft retained as an explicit exploratory/date-unknown exception; S7 is a dated supervised grey report.
counting_unit: One included full-text study per independently evaluated comparative neural family; variants, repeated seeds, feature runs and ensembles do not create additional studies.

original_full_text_cohort.note: Subset sensitivity, not proof of indexing, Q1 or peer review of remaining studies

expanded_without_undated_S6.note: Subset sensitivity, not proof of indexing, Q1 or peer review of remaining studies

expanded_without_explicit_grey_S2_S6_S7.note: Subset sensitivity, not proof of indexing, Q1 or peer review of remaining studies

rule_order: Record exact application, admissibility, publication/date status, comparative role and full-text evidence before counting; generic architecture references and author-code classes alone do not count as applied baseline studies.

Separate independent nonlinear neural baselines from proposed hybrids, forecast ensembles, linear-only networks and heads embedded inside another model; preserve unidirectional and bidirectional variants.

Count each family once per included study; report the original, expanded, date-known and explicit-grey sensitivity strata without retrospectively calling the expansion a preregistered systematic review.
Rank recurrence observed within the declared cohort; compare source depth and analytical parameter counts under common p5/q1 with source widths, bias conventions and remaining unknowns explicit.

Review simplicity, reproducibility and nonredundancy jointly after ranking; LSTM and GRU share recurrence but are not identical, so GRU must not be excluded automatically for a more diverse-looking trio.

Retain exactly three final DL baselines only if the evidence supports all guide criteria; otherwise keep documentary profiles provisional and expand/corroborate the evidence rather than force a third architecture.

rank_by_family_frequency.variant_caution: The chosen unidirectional variant appears3/5, not4/5.

rank_by_family_frequency.source_caution: Both supporting full texts are grey; S6 undated and architecture incomplete.
The published tuned S1 configuration is large and library version is unpinned.

selected_families_meaning: No final experimental trio is frozen. The three documentary working profiles are retained for review, not a frequency/minimum-complexity certification.

working_profile_omitted_candidate.reason: The earlier three-profile set prioritized recurrent/convolutional/attention diversity. That post-inspection choice does not prove frequency/minimum complexity or justify omitting GRU, which ties attention and exceeds TCN in the expanded corpus.

complexity_evidence.source_hyperparameter_correction: S1 Appendix C Tables5-6 PDF pages10-11 contain LSTM261,GRU43 and TCN287/k5/base4 winners; winners are not missing.
complexity_evidence.LSTM_source_small_variant: S5 LSTM20 yields1781 source parameters and2101/2181 under p5/q1 for one/two-bias conventions; these are analytical, not instantiated.
complexity_evidence.GRU_vs_LSTM: At S1 tuned widths, GRU43 has fewer parameters than LSTM261; that does not establish a family-wide ordering against the smaller S5 LSTM20.
complexity_evidence.TCN: Conditional six-block two-convolution one-stack no-norm count; source receptive field10921. No claim that this winner is a shallow minimal CNN1D.
complexity_evidence.S6: No exact parameter total; feedforward width, pooling/readout, positional and normalization details missing.
complexity_evidence.S7: Two LSTM layers64/32 plus Dense16ReLU and Dense1; p12 in report versus p8 in code gives32673 versus31649 analytical one-bias parameters. These are alternatives, not one certified replicated total.

limitations: WoS/Scopus/IEEE queries remain unexecuted unless supported by new exports; GitHub author-copy recovery does not establish indexing or journal quartile.
LSTM3/5 unidirectional, family4/5; GRU2/5; TCN1/5; encoder2/5 apply only to this exploratory cohort.
S2/S6/S7 are grey literature; S6 has no publication year, and S5 editorial year remains externally uncorroborated.
S6 nine feature specifications are one study; S7 Dense16 is part of LSTM, not an independent MLP baseline.
None of the supporting studies establishes the identical OHLCV Spot daily sigma7/h1 project contract.
Source tuned winners need not be basic/minimal; analytical examples do not select a project width, depth or architecture.
No own DL performance, pilot, benchmark, test evaluation or statistical superiority is established.
decision_timing: The expansion and corrected rule are documented after corpus inspection; not a retrospective claim of preregistration.
